evidence.title: Run AI workloads on any cloud, store on Hugging Face: zero-egress storage with SkyPilot

summary: SkyPilot now allows users to run AI workloads on any cloud provider while storing data on Hugging Face without egress fees. This integration aims to reduce costs and streamline multi-cloud AI development.
title: SkyPilot Enables Zero-Egress AI Workloads Across Clouds with Hugging Face Storage
